programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Mega - Dubai
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season.

programme.title: Football - Brazilian League: Vitoria - Fluminense
programme.desc: Brasileirao Seria A is the first Brazilian league founded in 1959. Due to geographical reasons, the history of the single league in Brazil is relatively short. Only with the development of civil aviation did Brazil get a unique football league. There are currently 20 teams participating in the league in a two-round competition system. During its existence, Serie A has given the soccer world some of the best players in history. Pele, Socrates, Garrincha and Ronaldinho are just one of them. The extremely attacking and attractive orientation of the game and the fanatical and numerous support from the stands are the reason why Serie A is one of the most exciting competitions on the planet.

programme.title: Football - German league: HSV - B. Monchengladbach
programme.desc: Along with all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga also stands proudly. The highest rank of the football competition, founded in 1963, has 18 teams that start the race for the popular plate every August. It was won the most times by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The culture of cheering, full stands and top football is what adorns the Bundesliga from its beginnings, until today. Don't miss every possible opportunity to enjoy Bundesliga matches. You certainly won't regret it.

programme.title: Football - French League: Toulouse - Strasbourg
programme.desc: Ligue 1 is the first French professional football league with 20 teams fighting for the title of French champion. It was founded in 1932 and is considered one of the most respected European leagues. The club with the most trophies with ten titles won is AS Saint Etienne, but the Greens have been waiting for a new title since 1981 and the time of the great Michel Platini. The matches of the French league are an unmissable event for every fan of this magnificent game.

programme.title: Football - English league: Everton - Coventry
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams begin the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season.
